fire.nirncraft.line.grief.1: It came out of the sky. Just like that.
fire.nirncraft.line.grief.2: They were at the well. I saw them go.
fire.nirncraft.line.grief.3: Gods, the smell of it. I can't stop smelling it.
fire.nirncraft.line.grief.4: I should have taken the road yesterday.
fire.nirncraft.line.grief.5: He said he'd be back before the noon bell.
fire.nirncraft.line.survivor.1: Is the road clear? Tell me the road is clear.
fire.nirncraft.line.survivor.2: We have bread, if you have a fire to share.
fire.nirncraft.line.survivor.3: The wall held. Everything else... no.
fire.nirncraft.line.survivor.4: Don't go near the keep. The beams are still coming down.
fire.nirncraft.line.survivor.5: Whoever you are, the soldiers at the gate will want your name.
fire.nirncraft.line.survivor.6: I keep counting the roofs. There were more of them.
fire.nirncraft.line.child.2: Is the big thing coming back?
fire.nirncraft.line.mourn.1: Rest easy. The stones will remember you.
fire.nirncraft.line.mourn.2: We'll give them to the fire by dusk.
fire.nirncraft.line.mourn.4: Eight we know. There may be more under the walls.
fire.nirncraft.line.healer.1: Stay still. Let me see that.
fire.nirncraft.line.healer.2: Water, and clean linen. Anyone with linen?
fire.nirncraft.line.healer.3: You'll live. Many won't. Sit down.
fire.nirncraft.line.healer.4: If it turns black, come straight back to me.
fire.nirncraft.line.healer.5: Stendarr's mercy, there are so many.
fire.nirncraft.line.cook.2: Bowls back when you're done. We have so few.
fire.nirncraft.line.cook.3: Eat. You can't dig on an empty belly.
fire.nirncraft.line.worker.1: Mind the beam. Lift on three.
fire.nirncraft.line.worker.4: We'll have this cleared by winter. Maybe.
fire.nirncraft.line.worker.5: Keep moving. The fire's not done with us.
fire.nirncraft.line.bucket.1: Pass it along! Don't spill it!
fire.nirncraft.line.bucket.4: My arms are gone, don't stop!
fire.nirncraft.line.guard.1: Move along. Keep to the road.
fire.nirncraft.line.guard.2: Nobody leaves without a word to the captain.
fire.nirncraft.line.guard.3: The Legion is holding Helgen. What's left of it.
fire.nirncraft.line.guard.4: Watch the sky. Always the sky.
fire.nirncraft.line.captain.2: Healers to the square, bearers to the keep!
fire.nirncraft.line.captain.3: Eyes up. If it returns, scatter and take cover.
fire.nirncraft.line.captain.4: Count the living first. Then the rest.
fire.nirncraft.line.captain.5: Don't loot the dead. Not while I'm watching.
fire.nirncraft.line.patient.2: My leg. I can't feel my leg.
fire.nirncraft.line.looter.1: What? I'm... helping. Looking for family.
fire.nirncraft.line.pray.1: Mara, hold them close. Stendarr, hold us.
fire.nirncraft.line.pray.2: Shh. Not now. I am asking for them.
fire.nirncraft.line.pray.3: Talos stands with Helgen. He has to.
fire.nirncraft.line.pray.4: Arkay, take them gently. Take them all gently.
fire.nirncraft.line.priest.1: Light a candle. They should not go in the dark.
fire.nirncraft.line.priest.2: The Eight keep a place for each of them. I have to believe that.
fire.nirncraft.line.priest.3: Kneel if you wish. Or simply stand with us.
fire.nirncraft.line.priest.4: Say the names you know. Someone must carry them.
fire.nirncraft.line.night.1: Don't walk the streets after dark. The walls still fall.
fire.nirncraft.line.night.2: I can't sleep. Every shadow looks like wings.
fire.nirncraft.line.night.3: Keep your voice down. The little ones are finally asleep.
fire.nirncraft.line.wary.1: Put that away. We have seen enough blades this week.
fire.nirncraft.line.wary.2: Are you here to help, or to take? Sheathe it.
fire.nirncraft.line.wary.3: The Legion is watching you. So am I.
fire.nirncraft.body.nothing: Nothing here but ash and cloth.
